issue.title: Retire legacy_agent_family_syntax
issue.description: SASE silently accepts the retired agent-family spellings as aliases of their agent-session replacements: %id(..., family=...), the family:/kind:family agent queries, --next-fork family, gate "fork": "family", and SASE_AGENT_FAMILY_ATTACH.

task_type_fields.remove_when: No maintained prompt, xprompt, skill, saved query, gate spec, or config in the sase-org repos or chezmoi still uses a retired agent-family spelling, and a sase release with agent-session syntax has shipped.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: SASE rejects those spellings with an error naming the agent-session replacement and ignores the legacy environment variable.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: SASE silently accepts the retired agent-family spellings as aliases of their agent-session replacements: %id(..., family=...), the family:/kind:family agent queries, --next-fork family, gate "fork": "family", and SASE_AGENT_FAMILY_ATTACH.
